title: Gulbanafsa Sarbat
description: Gulbanafsa Sarbat (Sharbat-e-Banafsha) is a specialized herbal syrup made from Sweet Violet flowers (Viola odorata), traditionally used for respiratory and digestive care. This classical formulation relieves chest congestion. Treats chronic catarrh. Manages flu. Treats common colds. Acts as a mild laxative.
dosage: 15–20 ml mixed in a cup of warm water or milk at bedtime
